# Azizam

Azizam is a self-hosted AI gateway. It puts the AI engines you run, and any paid providers you choose, behind one OpenAI-compatible address, with its own key, access plan and spend cap for each person and app.

Unlisted prelaunch preview. Azizam is in private preview. This site is static and is not an AI API endpoint.

- Examples (real recorded requests): /examples/
- Documentation: /docs/
- API guide (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, A1111 shapes; media jobs; MCP): /docs/api/
- Setup guide: /docs/start/install/
